name: pdtlbw
oracle_status: BLOCKED — the refs qemu-system-i386 oracle is un-buildable in this environment (needs python3-venv + root). The differential verify-sys golden is therefore infeasible here; this test is SELF-CHECKING in the guest (the read-back comparison drives the isa-debug-exit AL: 0x42->status 133 PASS, 0x21->status 67 FAIL), so the RTL validates it stand-alone WITHOUT the oracle. Run on a FE_PIPE-enabled TB (the bug is FE_PIPE-specific).
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to 32-bit flat code 0x08)
paging enable (CR3=0x11000, CR0.PG 0->1; FULL identity map of [0,4MiB), P|RW|US, D=0)
CPL0 16-bit-PM store of the sentinel to the clean (D=0), identity-mapped, US=1 target page 0x30

HARDWARE TASK SWITCH: far JMP $0x30,$0 -> TSS_B @ 0x10000 (S_TSW_SAVE saves TSS_A page 0x20, S_TSW_READ reads TSS_B page 0x10 -- both NON-translatable states; all three TSS/target pages collide at D-TLB index 0)
TSS_B task reads the target linear back and compares to the sentinel; isa-debug-exit AL=0x42 on PASS, 0x21 on FAIL
description: Ventium task #102 — DATA-STORE-UNDER-PAGING micro-TLB regression for the +VEN_FE_PIPE registered micro-TLB (fe_dtlb_*). The CWSDPMI INT 0x31 dispatcher class of bug: a paged store to a clean (PTE.D=0), identity-mapped, user-accessible page, with a HARDWARE TASK SWITCH (S_TSW_SAVE/S_TSW_READ -- NON-translatable states that drive cur_lin=0 with cur_is_d=1) between the store and the read-back, on pages that all collide at the direct-mapped D-TLB index 0 (lin[15:12]). Pre-fix, the FE_PIPE re-registration fired in those non-translatable states and cached an INCONSISTENT page-keyed entry (fe_dtlb_page vs fe_dtlb_phys for different pages), and mem_xlate used the registered frame without a page-match guard, so a colliding-page access could be mis-translated. The fix gates the micro-TLB re-registration on fe_translatable (a genuine paged access) and guards mem_xlate's registered-frame use on (fe_*_v && fe_*_page==lin[31:12]); see core.sv. This test exercises that exact path and self-checks the read-back equals the store under a FE_PIPE-enabled config. NOTE: the bug is FE_PIPE-specific (only the registered micro-TLB has the re-register window); a non-FE_PIPE build is immune, so a non-FE_PIPE run will not exercise it. The qemu-system differential golden is BLOCKED (oracle un-buildable here); the test is self-checking via the exit status so it validates on the RTL alone.
